component-metadata.author: knimeuser
component-metadata.description:
Metanode for computation of selected descriptive statistics for selected columns.
Selected descriptive statistics are: count - count of numerical values mad - median absolute deviation max - maximum min - minimum median - median mean - mean sem - standard error of the mean sum - sum std - standard deviation var - variance
Statistics are calculated using pandas DataFrame statistics, more details can be found e.g. here https://pandas.pydata.org/pandas-docs/stable/reference/frame.html#computations-descriptive-stats
Sum function returns missing value in case of only missing values sum (default pandas behavior was adjusted in this matter).
You can select what descriptive statistics should be calculated, prefix and suffix (added prior and after the sample name got from the design matrix) for newly added columns. New columns will be named as "prefix""sample name""suffix""statistics name" (i.e. without any space or delimiter).
